items.name: 松石涟漪
items.brief: Revise the teal-cream kit. Keep the deep jade-teal #176D64 and cream #F2E4C9 canopy stripes. Motif: simple elegant ivory RIPPLE / flowing water arcs. items.name: 星愿蓝紫
items.brief: COMPLETELY REPLACE the orange/cocoa palette with a clearly different blue-VIOLET STARRY-NIGHT kit. Menu frame violet with star crest; plate cream with tiny star rim; tiny violet end-cap on wok handle. Fixed stall wood medium warm walnut with golden highlights, no violet wood.
